_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "exercise_type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id), "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise_categories (id), "target_sets" INTEGER NULL, "target_reps" INTEGER NULL, "target_rpe" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id), "workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id), "date_str" TEXT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_phases" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "length_passes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deload_every" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "phase_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "phase_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_phases (id), "workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "phase_exercise_targets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "phase_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_phases (id), "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise_categories (id), "target_rpe" INTEGER NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NULL, "target_reps" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id), "phase_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plan_phases (id), "workout_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workouts (id), "pass" INTEGER NULL, "closes_pass" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("closes_pass" IN (0, 1)), "date_str" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_images" ("category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise_categories (id), "data" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise_categories (id), "date_str" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL, "time_secs" INTEGER NULL, "rpe" INTEGER NULL, "grade" TEXT NULL, "wall_angle" INTEGER NULL, "climb_name" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_notes" ("date_str" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date_str"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weights" ("date_str" TEXT NOT NULL, "kg" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date_str"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspirations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES exercise_categories (id), "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_we_workout ON workout_exercises (workout_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_we_category ON workout_exercises (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pw_plan ON plan_workouts (plan_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pw_workout ON plan_workouts (workout_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_phase_plan ON plan_phases (plan_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_ps_phase ON phase_sessions (phase_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX idx_ps_workout ON phase_sessions (workout_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pet_phase ON phase_exercise_targets (phase_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pet_category ON phase_exercise_targets (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pe_plan ON plan_events (plan_id, timestamp)
CREATE INDEX idx_pe_phase ON plan_events (phase_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pe_workout ON plan_events (workout_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sets_date ON workout_sets (date_str, timestamp)
CREATE INDEX idx_sets_category ON workout_sets (category_id, date_str)
CREATE INDEX idx_inspirations_category ON inspirations (category_id)
